quarter.basis: announced date as derived by the extractor (standalone date line in the body), not the harvester's item date — see docs/disclosure-events.md finding 2 (iso_date bug).

date_eligibility.basis: source-adjudicated announced date — the date as adjudicated against the EGX source document (header/body), not the extractor's derived announced date. Supersedes the extractor-derived basis above for eligibility decisions.
date_eligibility.rule: a source document is in-quarter when start <= adjudicated announced date <= end (both endpoints inclusive); a document announced exactly on 2026-08-19 or exactly on 2026-11-19 is eligible. Eligibility is frozen from the adjudicated date, never re-derived from extractor output, so an extraction error cannot choose its own recall denominator.
date_eligibility.matches_extractor: scripts/disclosure_events.py marks an event stale when d < QUARTER_START or d > QUARTER_END (both endpoints inclusive) at main 424f4b3

A genuine zero-activity result needs complete source-enumeration evidence — never zero disclosures by default.
